title: The Toad Oracle
text: A toad the size of a dog squats on a stone in the reeds, warty and wet, its throat swelling and sinking. It croaks, very clearly, the name of a Scion. Then it waits, its gold eyes fixed on them.

options.label: The named Scion listens to the toad, since it called for them.

outcomes.text: It tells them their fortune. It is a good one.

options.label: Feed it a fly, and see what a full toad will say.

outcomes.text: It croaks the way out of the marsh, and what waits along it.

options.label: The Leader kicks it off its stone. No toad names a Scion of the House.

outcomes.text: Every toad in the marsh hears, and every one of them is poisonous.
